# Annals theorems in Lean

A static review site for one run of an automated pipeline that states the
main theorem of each *Annals of Mathematics* paper in Lean 4 on Mathlib
(statement only, proof `sorry`): a finder selects the theorem, two
language-model formalizers each write a Lean library stating it, an
adjudicator judges faithfulness and picks. Every file the models wrote, their
reports, the build checks and the adjudication are shown for human review.

## Data

`data/` is generated by the exporter in the
[autoformalization](https://github.com/epoch-research/autoformalization/tree/buzzard-annals)
repo (`autoformalization/annals_site/export.py`) from one Hawk eval set's log
and artifacts, and committed as-is. It is Vite's public directory, so the site
fetches exactly these files (Lean is highlighted in the browser):

- `index.json` — the list (one row per paper: decision, winner, both
  candidates' size/outcome/verdict, cost) and the run's metadata (models,
  budgets, Mathlib commit, totals per formalizer)
- `papers/<arxiv id>.json` — one paper: its metadata, the selected main theorem
  (TeX, a readable rendering, the finder's reasons and rejected alternatives,
  the paper's macro definitions for KaTeX), each candidate (the formalizer's
  report, the harness's build check, the adjudicator's verdict, the file list,
  the root module's text), the adjudication and the costs per stage
- `trees/<arxiv id>/<cid>/**` — every file a formalizer wrote, byte for byte
  as harvested from the sandbox (the file browser fetches these; they are also
  plain files to read here)
- `trees/<arxiv id>/<arxiv id>-<cid>.zip` — the same files as one download
- `scratch/<arxiv id>/<cid|adjudicator>/**` — the text files an agent left in
  its scratch directory

```sh
uv run python -m autoformalization.annals_site.export \
  --log logs/<eval-set>/<log>.eval --out <this repo>/data
```

## Local development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm dev        # dev server on http://localhost:5173/
pnpm build      # check data, typecheck, bundle into dist/
pnpm preview    # serve dist/
```

Node ≥ 22.13 (`.tool-versions` pins one). Pushes to `main` deploy to GitHub
Pages through `.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml`.

## Fonts

Libertinus Sans and Libertinus Mono (`src/fonts/`, SIL Open Font License), as
on the sibling sites.

/-!
# Automorphy lifting over CM fields: the Fontaine--Laffaille case

This is the statement of Theorem 6.1.1, label `thm:main_automorphy_lifting_theorem`, of
Allen et al., *Potential automorphy over CM fields*, arXiv:1812.09999.

The input automorphic representation, its weight, and the coefficient-field isomorphism
are explicit witnesses, since the conclusion uses the same weight and isomorphism and
its final ramification condition uses the input automorphic representation.

`IsAssociated` expresses isomorphism with `r_ι(π)` by its unramified Hecke-polynomial
characterization. Residual representations are semisimplified reductions. Crystallinity
at places above `p` is quantified over p-adic embeddings, which parametrize these places
with repetition; the labelled Hodge--Tate condition uses the same embeddings.
-/

@[expose] public noncomputable section

namespace PotentialAutomorphy

open NumberField Matrix

/-- **The Fontaine--Laffaille automorphy lifting theorem** (Allen, Calegari, Caraiani, Gee,
Helm, Le Hung, Newton, Scholze, Taylor and Thorne, *Potential automorphy over CM fields*,
Annals of Mathematics 197 (2023), arXiv:1812.09999, Theorem 6.1.1,
label `thm:main_automorphy_lifting_theorem`).

Let `F` be imaginary CM or totally real, and let `ρ : G_F → GL_n(ℚ̄_p)` be continuous,
unramified almost everywhere and crystalline above an unramified prime `p`. Suppose its
semisimplified residual representation is absolutely irreducible and decomposed generic,
has enormous image on `G_{F(ζ_p)}`, and takes a scalar value at an element outside that
subgroup. Assume `p > n²`. If `ρ` is residually automorphic of regular algebraic weight `λ`,
with the specified labelled Hodge--Tate weights and a spherical input representation at `p`,
and `λ_{τ,1}+λ_{τc,1}-λ_{τ,n}-λ_{τc,n} < p-2n` for every `τ`, then `ρ` is automorphic of that
same weight. The output is unramified above `p` and at every finite place at which both `ρ`
and the input automorphic representation are unramified. No self-duality is assumed.

`n` is positive; `ℤ` is used for the weight bound and the Hodge--Tate shifts. The cyclotomic
character has Hodge--Tate weight `-1`. -/
theorem automorphy_lifting
    (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F]
    (hF : IsCMField F ∨ IsTotallyReal F)
    (c : F ≃ₐ[ℚ] F) (hc : ∀ τ : F →+* ℂ, ComplexEmbedding.IsConj τ c)
    (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [NeZero n]
    (ρ : GaloisRepresentation F (PadicAlgCl p) n)
    (rbar : GaloisRepresentation F (ResidueField p) n)
    (h_reduction : rbar.toMatrixRep.IsResidualOf ρ.toMatrixRep)
    (h_unramified : ρ.toMatrixRep.IsUnramifiedAlmostEverywhere)
    (h_crystalline : ∀ τ : F →+* PadicAlgCl p, IsCrystallineAt ρ.toMatrixRep τ)
    (h_p_unramified : IsUnramifiedPrime F p)
    (h_irreducible : rbar.toMatrixRep.IsAbsolutelyIrreducible)
    (h_generic : rbar.toMatrixRep.IsDecomposedGeneric p)
    (h_enormous : IsEnormous (ResidueField p) n p
      ((cyclotomicKernel F p).map rbar.toMatrixRep))
    (h_scalar : ∃ σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup F, σ ∉ cyclotomicKernel F p ∧
      ∃ a : (ResidueField p)ˣ, rbar σ = GeneralLinearGroup.scalar (Fin n) a)
    (h_p_large : n ^ 2 < p)
    (π : CuspidalAutomorphicRepresentation F n) (weight : Weight F n)
    (h_weight : π.HasWeight weight)
    (h_weight_range : ∀ τ : F →+* ℂ,
      weight.val τ 0 + weight.val (τ.comp c.toRingHom) 0 -
        weight.val τ (Fin.rev 0) - weight.val (τ.comp c.toRingHom) (Fin.rev 0) <
          (p : ℤ) - 2 * (n : ℤ))
    (ι : PadicAlgCl p ≃+* ℂ)
    (h_residual_automorphy : ∃ rπ : GaloisRepresentation F (PadicAlgCl p) n,
      IsAssociated rπ π ι ∧ rbar.toMatrixRep.IsResidualOf rπ.toMatrixRep)
    (h_hodge_tate : ∀ τ : F →+* PadicAlgCl p,
      HasHodgeTateWeights τ ρ.toMatrixRep (weight.hodgeTateWeights (ι.toRingHom.comp τ)))
    (h_spherical : ∀ v : FinitePlace F, v.LiesAbove p → π.IsUnramifiedAt v) :
    ∃ π' : CuspidalAutomorphicRepresentation F n,
      π'.HasWeight weight ∧ IsAssociated ρ π' ι ∧
        ∀ v : FinitePlace F,
          (v.LiesAbove p ∨ (ρ.toMatrixRep.IsUnramifiedAt v ∧ π.IsUnramifiedAt v)) →
            π'.IsUnramifiedAt v := by
  sorry

end PotentialAutomorphy

public import Candidate.PadicHodge.CrystallinePeriodRing

/-!
# Crystalline representations

The Galois action on `B_cris` is obtained functorially from the action on `ℂ_p`: first on
the integral tilt, then Witt vectors, the divided-power envelope, its completion, and the
localization. A representation is crystalline when its extension to
`ℚ̄_p ⊗_{ℚ_p} B_cris` has a basis of invariant periods. This is the usual
`B_cris`-admissibility definition, in matrix form.
-/

@[expose] public noncomputable section

namespace PotentialAutomorphy

open Ideal Matrix
open scoped TensorProduct

variable (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]

/-- The Galois action on the integral tilt, obtained from the action modulo `p`. -/
def integralTiltAction (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ_[p]) : IntegralTilt p →+* IntegralTilt p :=
  Perfection.map p
    (Ideal.quotientMap (Ideal.span {(p : PadicComplexInt p)}) (padicComplexIntAction p σ) (by
      sorry))

/-- The natural Galois action on `A_inf`. -/
def aInfAction (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ_[p]) : AInf p →+* AInf p :=
  WittVector.map (integralTiltAction p σ)

/-- Extension of the Galois action to the fraction field of `A_inf`. -/
def aInfFractionAction (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ_[p]) :
    FractionRing (AInf p) →+* FractionRing (AInf p) :=
  IsFractionRing.lift (g := (algebraMap (AInf p) (FractionRing (AInf p))).comp
    (aInfAction p σ)) (by
      sorry)

/-- The Galois action preserves the divided-power envelope. -/
def aCrisPreAction (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ_[p]) : aCrisPre p →+* aCrisPre p :=
  ((aInfFractionAction p σ).comp (aCrisPre p).subtype).codRestrict (aCrisPre p) (by
    sorry)

/-- Functoriality of an adic completion for an endomorphism preserving the defining ideal. -/
def adicCompletionMap {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (f : R →+* R)
    (hf : I ≤ I.comap f) : AdicCompletion I R →+* AdicCompletion I R :=
  AdicCompletion.liftRingHom I
    (fun m ↦ (Ideal.quotientMap (I ^ m) f (by
      exact (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).mp
        ((Ideal.map_pow f I m).le.trans (pow_le_pow_left'
          ((Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).mpr hf) m)))).comp (AdicCompletion.evalₐ I m).toRingHom)
    (by
      sorry)

/-- The Galois action on `A_cris`. -/
def aCrisAction (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ_[p]) : ACris p →+* ACris p :=
  adicCompletionMap (crystallineIdeal p) (aCrisPreAction p σ) (by
    sorry)

/-- The Galois action on `B_cris`; the denominators are preserved because the action permutes
compatible systems of primitive roots and fixes `p`. -/
def bCrisAction (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ_[p]) : BCris p →ₐ[ℚ_[p]] BCris p where
  toRingHom := IsLocalization.map (M := crystallineDenominators p)
    (T := crystallineDenominators p) (S := BCris p) (BCris p) (aCrisAction p σ) (by
    sorry)
  commutes' := by
    sorry

instance : Nontrivial (BCris p) := by
  sorry

/-- `B_cris` with algebraically closed p-adic coefficients (the coefficients are not acted on). -/
abbrev CrystallineRing : Type := PadicAlgCl p ⊗[ℚ_[p]] BCris p

/-- The action on crystalline periods with fixed coefficient field. -/
def crystallineRingAction (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup ℚ_[p]) :
    CrystallineRing p →ₐ[PadicAlgCl p] CrystallineRing p :=
  Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (PadicAlgCl p) (PadicAlgCl p)) (bCrisAction p σ)

variable {F : Type*} [Field F] {n : ℕ} {p}

/-- Crystallinity at the p-adic place determined by `τ`: after extending scalars to the
crystalline period ring there is a basis fixed by the local Galois group.

The matrix `b` has invariant columns, so the equation is `r(g) g(b) = b`. Equivalently the
usual crystalline comparison map is an isomorphism. -/
def IsCrystallineAt (r : MatrixRep (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup F) (PadicAlgCl p) n)
    (τ : F →+* PadicAlgCl p) : Prop :=
  ∃ b : GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (CrystallineRing p),
    ∀ σ : padicDecompositionGroup p τ,
      GeneralLinearGroup.map (algebraMap (PadicAlgCl p) (CrystallineRing p))
        (r (localToGlobal p τ σ)) *
          GeneralLinearGroup.map (crystallineRingAction p σ.val).toRingHom b = b

end PotentialAutomorphy

module

public import Candidate.PadicHodge.LocalGalois

/-!
# Fontaine's crystalline period ring

We construct `A_cris` as the `p`-adic completion of the subring of `Frac(A_inf)` generated
by `A_inf` and `x^m/m!` for `x ∈ ker θ`. For the perfectoid valuation ring `𝓞_{ℂ_p}` this
is the usual torsion-free divided-power envelope. We use Mathlib's Witt vectors, pretilt,
Fontaine theta map, fraction field, adic completion and localization constructions.

`B_cris` inverts `p` and the logarithms of compatible systems of primitive p-power roots
of unity. Inverting all such logarithms, rather than selecting one system, removes the
irrelevant choice of a generator of `ℤ_p(1)`; all these logarithms differ by `ℤ_pˣ`.
-/

@[expose] public noncomputable section

namespace PotentialAutomorphy

open Ideal

variable (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]

instance : Fact (¬IsUnit (p : PadicComplexInt p)) := by
  constructor
  intro h
  have he := (PadicComplexInt.integers p).one_of_isUnit h
  have hpval : (PadicComplex.valued p).v (p : PadicComplex p) = 1 := by
    simpa using he
  rw [PadicComplex.valuation_p] at hpval
  have : (p : NNReal) = 1 := inv_eq_one.mp (by simpa only [one_div] using hpval)
  exact (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one (by exact_mod_cast this)

instance : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {(p : PadicComplexInt p)}) (PadicComplexInt p) := by
  sorry

/-- The integral tilt of `ℂ_p`. -/
abbrev IntegralTilt : Type := PreTilt (PadicComplexInt p) p

instance : IsDomain (IntegralTilt p) :=
  PreTilt.isDomain (PadicComplex p) (PadicComplex.valued p).v (PadicComplexInt p)
    (PadicComplexInt.integers p) p

/-- Fontaine's `A_inf = W(𝓞_{ℂ_p}^♭)`. -/
abbrev AInf : Type := WittVector p (IntegralTilt p)

/-- Fontaine's theta map for the p-adic complex numbers. -/
def fontaineTheta : AInf p →+* PadicComplexInt p :=
  WittVector.fontaineTheta (PadicComplexInt p) p

/-- The divided-power envelope before p-adic completion, realized inside the fraction field
of `A_inf`. This realization removes p-torsion, as in the classical definition of `A_cris`. -/
def aCrisPre : Subring (FractionRing (AInf p)) :=
  Subring.closure (Set.range (algebraMap (AInf p) (FractionRing (AInf p))) ∪
    {y | ∃ (x : AInf p) (m : ℕ), fontaineTheta p x = 0 ∧
      y = (algebraMap (AInf p) (FractionRing (AInf p)) x) ^ m /
        (m.factorial : FractionRing (AInf p))})

/-- The canonical inclusion of `A_inf` into its divided-power envelope. -/
def aInfToCrisPre : AInf p →+* aCrisPre p :=
  (algebraMap (AInf p) (FractionRing (AInf p))).codRestrict (aCrisPre p)
    (fun x ↦ Subring.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨x, rfl⟩))

/-- The ideal of definition for the crystalline completion. -/
def crystallineIdeal : Ideal (aCrisPre p) := Ideal.span {(p : aCrisPre p)}

/-- Fontaine's integral crystalline period ring. -/
abbrev ACris : Type := AdicCompletion (crystallineIdeal p) (aCrisPre p)

/-- The natural map from `A_inf` to `A_cris`. -/
def aInfToCris : AInf p →+* ACris p :=
  (algebraMap (aCrisPre p) (ACris p)).comp (aInfToCrisPre p)

/-- The p-adic integers in `A_inf`, via `ℤ_p = W(𝔽_p)`. -/
def padicIntToAInf : ℤ_[p] →+* AInf p :=
  (WittVector.map (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) (IntegralTilt p))).comp
    (WittVector.fromPadicInt p)

/-- A generator of the Tate module of p-power roots of unity. -/
structure CompatibleRoots where
  /-- Its roots of unity in the ring of p-adic complex integers. -/
  root : ℕ → PadicComplexInt p
  /-- Compatibility under the p-th power maps. -/
  pow_eq : ∀ m : ℕ, root (m + 1) ^ p = root m
  /-- Primitivity at every level, including `root 0 = 1`. -/
  is_primitive_root : ∀ m : ℕ, IsPrimitiveRoot (root m) (p ^ m)

namespace CompatibleRoots

/-- A compatible system of roots defines an element of the integral tilt. -/
def tilt (ε : CompatibleRoots p) : IntegralTilt p :=
  ⟨fun m ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(p : PadicComplexInt p)}) (ε.root m), by
    intro m
    rw [← map_pow, ε.pow_eq]⟩

/-- The element `[ε] - 1` in `A_inf`. -/
def mu (ε : CompatibleRoots p) : AInf p := WittVector.teichmuller p (ε.tilt p) - 1

/-- The element `[ε] - 1` is in the kernel of Fontaine's theta map. -/
theorem theta_mu (ε : CompatibleRoots p) : fontaineTheta p (ε.mu p) = 0 := by
  sorry

/-- The `m`-th term of `log([ε])`, numbered starting at zero. Its integrality in the
divided-power envelope follows from `x^(m+1)/(m+1) = m! γ_(m+1)(x)`. -/
def logarithmTerm (ε : CompatibleRoots p) (m : ℕ) : aCrisPre p :=
  ⟨(-1 : FractionRing (AInf p)) ^ m * (m.factorial : FractionRing (AInf p)) *
      ((algebraMap (AInf p) (FractionRing (AInf p)) (ε.mu p)) ^ (m + 1) /
        ((m + 1).factorial : FractionRing (AInf p))), by
    apply (aCrisPre p).mul_mem
    · apply (aCrisPre p).mul_mem
      · exact (aCrisPre p).pow_mem ((aCrisPre p).neg_mem (aCrisPre p).one_mem) m
      · exact natCast_mem (aCrisPre p) m.factorial
    · exact Subring.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨ε.mu p, m + 1, ε.theta_mu p, rfl⟩)⟩

/-- Partial sums of the logarithm, indexed so that the `m`-th sum is stable modulo `p^m`.
The quadratic reindexing is cofinal and avoids any assumptions on `p` beyond primality. -/
def logarithmPartialSum (ε : CompatibleRoots p) (m : ℕ) : aCrisPre p :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((m + 1) ^ 2 * p), ε.logarithmTerm p j

/-- The chosen partial sums are p-adically Cauchy. -/
theorem logarithm_isAdicCauchy (ε : CompatibleRoots p) :
    AdicCompletion.IsAdicCauchy (crystallineIdeal p) (aCrisPre p)
      (ε.logarithmPartialSum p) := by
  sorry

/-- Fontaine's period `t = log([ε])` in `A_cris`. -/
def logarithm (ε : CompatibleRoots p) : ACris p :=
  AdicCompletion.mk (crystallineIdeal p) (aCrisPre p)
    ⟨ε.logarithmPartialSum p, ε.logarithm_isAdicCauchy p⟩

end CompatibleRoots

/-- The elements to be inverted to obtain `B_cris`. -/
def crystallineDenominators : Submonoid (ACris p) :=
  Submonoid.closure ({(p : ACris p)} ∪ Set.range (CompatibleRoots.logarithm p))

/-- Fontaine's crystalline period ring. -/
abbrev BCris : Type := Localization (crystallineDenominators p)

/-- The p-adic integer scalars in the crystalline period ring. -/
def padicIntToBCris : ℤ_[p] →+* BCris p :=
  (algebraMap (ACris p) (BCris p)).comp ((aInfToCris p).comp (padicIntToAInf p))

/-- The p-adic rational scalars in the crystalline period ring. -/
def padicToBCris : ℚ_[p] →+* BCris p :=
  IsLocalization.lift (M := nonZeroDivisors ℤ_[p]) (g := padicIntToBCris p) (by
    sorry)

/-- The canonical p-adic scalar structure on the crystalline period ring. -/
instance : Algebra ℚ_[p] (BCris p) := (padicToBCris p).toAlgebra

end PotentialAutomorphy
